Hi Rachel —

We're starting our renewal planning for the account. Quick summary from our side: current term ends 2028-05-31, and usage has been consistently growing — we expect to need a 2.5x committed capacity for Q3 and Q4. We'd like to explore a one-year extension instead of the 12-month auto-renew (to align with our fiscal calendar) and add a capacity supplement (order form) to cover the uplift.

High-level asks:
- Move term end to 2029-05-31 (one-year extension)
- Add a capacity supplement for +2.5x GPUs / higher concurrency starting 2028-07-01

I've attached our internal renewal worksheet for context. Can you share the right renewal docs (MSA supplement, order form addendum) and an initial redline from your legal ops so we can circulate? Procurement wants to review commercial + any penalty/SLA changes.

Thanks —

Subject: RE: Solstice AI — MSA supplement redline (response)

Amaya / team — thanks for the redline. Quick legal position:
1) Overage cap: we can commit to a fixed overage cap stated in the order form (percentage) for the term, provided the cap is tied to the specific capacity schedule and the billing cadence. We'll set the cap at 25% above committed uplift; any usage beyond that will be billed at the flex rate.
2) Step-down credit: we can add an automatic quarterly true-up credit that triggers if actual billed consumption <50% of committed uplift for that quarter. The credit will be applied on the following invoice and capped at the amount of the uplift fees charged that quarter.
3) SLA / penalties: unchanged in main MSA. For capacity constraints, we'll include a limited remediation paragraph (notice + optional early termination if sustained shortfall >30 days).

I've updated the supplement redline with the above language and attached it. If Solstice agrees, we can prepare final DocuSign packet for signatures (MSA supplement + order form).

—Priyom
